prior_specification_disposition: V2 captured causal delayed books but omitted the market-published minimum share size. V3 resets the forward sample and requires that venue rule at source confirmation and order arrival.
selection_disclosure: The 0-10 second boundary band was selected after inspecting earlier Flow data. Every V1/V2 row, the 18-market 18/18 discovery result and every WAL replay are discovery only.
hypothesis: A completed wrong-way public sweep that is absorbed and followed by one-tick executable improvement in the opposite token during the final ten seconds contains terminal resolver information beyond the executable ask and crypto taker fee.

frozen_mechanics.market_scope: crypto direction markets with an authoritative scheduled resolver boundary and terminal outcome
frozen_mechanics.independence: first qualifying source signal per condition_id only; never stack one market
frozen_mechanics.arrival_rule: last causal CLOB book at or before intended arrival; reject stale, crossed, missing-capacity, connection-gap, post-boundary or non-marketable arrivals
frozen_mechanics.fill: FAK-style paper fill at arrival ask, min($10/ask, 20% displayed arrival ask size), at least $1 notional and at least the CLOB market's published minimum_order_size
frozen_mechanics.exit: hold to official terminal resolution; no post-boundary book exit is credited
frozen_mechanics.costs: exact entry taker fee; primary inference requires doubled entry-fee stress positive
frozen_mechanics.live_canary: separate event-driven executor; max $10, protected FAK worst price equal to the causal arrival ask, independent database and environment arming gates; live results never enter the paper forward cohort
frozen_mechanics.post_selected_parameter: The 10-second band remains PROVISIONAL and cannot use pre-freeze rows as evidence.
frozen_mechanics.mechanism_argument: Inside ten seconds, a completed wrong-way sweep followed by opposite-book improvement can reveal which side absorbed stale boundary flow. This is a resolver-state hypothesis, not a claim that discovery PnL is repeatable.

minimum_read.multiple_testing_correction: Holm correction across every Flow arm, information latency, order latency, horizon and inspected TTE bucket
minimum_read.capacity_metric: realized dollars per independent market at displayed 20%-touch capacity

failure_conditions: Either chronological half is non-positive at doubled entry fees
The market- or day-clustered 95% lower bound is not above zero
The 250ms cohort is negative or fewer than 90% of decisions have a persisted causal arrival book
Profit depends on an order below the venue minimum or arriving at/after the resolver boundary
Authenticated acknowledgement or fill slippage consumes the paper lower bound
zero_edge_disclosure: The discovery result may be selection noise or a paper-fill artifact. A zero or negative forward result is an expected and valid outcome.
